---
title: "check-bare-yes-no.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that fails when a pull request adds a solution paragraph
that opens with a bare "Yes." or "No.".
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-28) is that a yes-or-no answer says what it means
in the question's own terms, as in "No: it's not possible that the advanced network has a test error of 0.25."

The check looks inside a solution div (`#sol-...`, `.sol`, `.solution` or `.answer`)
for a paragraph or list item that begins with Yes or No, bare or in bold or italics,
followed by a period, an exclamation mark or nothing.
"No: ...", "No, ..." and "No other notes" pass.
Code fences and HTML comments are skipped.

An untouched answer is never reflagged.
With no base ref the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree;
`whole-tree` measures a corpus.

## Usage

Copy [`examples/check-bare-yes-no.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-bare-yes-no.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every solution, not only a pull request's additions |
| `runs-on` | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |
